subtopic: ANSI SQL Isolation Levels (Read Committed to Serializable)
question_text: What concurrency anomaly is permitted under READ COMMITTED isolation but prevented under REPEATABLE READ isolation?
answer_explanation: In Read Committed, re-reading a row after another transaction commits an update yields the new value (non-repeatable read). Repeatable Read uses snapshot MVCC reads to guarantee identical rows.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: In Read Committed, re-reading a row after another transaction commits an update yields the new value (non-repeatable read). Repeatable Read uses snapshot MVCC reads to guarantee identical rows.
